description: Rotate build-accumulator identity BEFORE the fallible startFresh on fresh-over-failed: today rotation/counter-reset run after startFresh (build.js:2482 vs 2467), so a retry of a failed build whose fresh plan throws emits a DUPLICATE build-actuals failed row under the old build_id with the prior attempt's stale counters, double-counting in ACRR. Surfaced by b6ecbd5 codex belt-and-braces review 2026-07-23 (P2, reachable single-process). Same review noted 2 concurrency-corner findings (P1a finalizeBuildAttempt clobbers a foreign live sidecar on pre-ownership failure; P1b post-verdict ownership non-atomic) — accepted as PID advisory-lock limitations, not in scope here unless concurrent same-feature builds become a real path.
